taskInput.request: Review and repair Lookup.find so each request respects its remaining budget while preserving the configured loader's lifecycle. Inspect the supplied artifacts before choosing the cancellation owner. Make the smallest Java 11-compatible change, and provide focused executable checks of caller outcome and cancellation observations. Reject invalid/expired budgets before acquiring work. Do not change deployment mode, registry semantics or dependencies.

files.loader-contract.md: Deployment reads loader.properties. In shared mode, acquire(key) coalesces concurrent calls for the same key and returns the same handle while its load is outstanding. The registry owns that load and enforces its separate 5-second lifetime. In exclusive mode, each acquire creates a fresh handle owned by that request, with the same 5-second fallback lifetime. All result fields are plain CompletableFuture<String>; the requestCancellation callback signals the actual owned task/transport separately and is idempotent. No durable asynchronous job acceptance exists. The local controllable fixture records cancellation calls and permits explicit owner completion; production remote release and effects need separate evidence. Do not implement last-waiter cancellation for the shared registry in this task.
